content: We conduct an analysis for the higher-resource dataset WMT 2014 English $\rightarrow $ German of the attention in the sparse adaptive Transformer model ($\alpha $-entmax) at multiple levels: we analyze high-level statistics as well as individual head behavior. Moreover, we make a qualitative analysis of the interpretability capabilities of our models.
